host_details:
Originally from Southern California.
While visiting Nashville for work I fell 
In love with a incredible city just south
of Nashville.  Franklin.  A key site of the 
American Civil War,  its home to 2 
Properties exploring the Battle of Franklin:
Carter House and the Carnton Plantation,
which includes the McGavock Confederate 
Cemetery.  The 1858 Lotz House contains a large collection of 19th-century furniture.
Downtown’s Main Street is lined with galleries,  antique shops and restored
Victorian buildings.
